stderr 'unknown flag|run'
! stdout .

! stdout .
! skygo run sky.yaml --sync-workdir --remote-data --workspace-state state

! stdout .
! skygo run sky.yaml --sync-workdir --workdir-ref= --workspace-state state
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run sky.yaml --workspace-state state
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run sky.yaml --workspace-state=
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run native.yaml --sync-workdir --workspace-state state
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run missing.yaml --sync-workdir --workspace-state state
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run null.yaml --sync-workdir --workspace-state state
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run sky.yaml --sync-workdir --request-domain= --workspace-state state
stderr .
! stdout .
workspace-requests 0
